about: Verdicts by hand on the 56 sites of out/gitlab_readpath_sample.json (gitlab_readpath_sample.py, 6 per template, seed 9), keyed by their position there. T = a cross-database read from the child to the parent that tolerates a missing parent; E = such a read that raises when the parent is gone; FP = not such a read (another model with the same association name, a writer path, generic code that never reaches this edge, or a reader that read the parent first).
